text: I feel tired . I also feel overworked and burnt out . I have 2 children under the age of 3 and I work 3 jobs and it’s a lot . The outcome of the elections stresses me as a women and immigrant . I’m worried about people being more racist and xenophobic and I’m worried about raising my children in this climate

I’m overworked and underpaid and I feel so burned out .   Working 3 jobs and having 2 under 3 aged kids is so tiring , I’m constantly dropping the ball and letting someone down . I just need a break or a vacation . I think about wanting a drink often but I feel like I can’t because I can’t afford being drunk or having a hangover .

I just ate dinner with the in-laws and now I’m trying to set up their dinner . It’s a very frustrating process as I keep hitting snags . I am sad because I’m missing time with my kids . They are happy and I’m happy that they are happy but I miss them .

It’s been a super long day and I’m going to bed early . I’m very very tired from not sleeping well and just a long day all together . The kids got new beds so they are having a hard time which is making me feel even more tired and burnt out .

I’m exhausted . The little one bumped her head and had to rush to urgent care to evaluate whether she needs stitches so I feel nervous and worried for my child . And because she’s my child , my anxiety is through the roof .

I’m happy because I’m home with my family , I’m just so exhausted and tired . But my daughter called me her hero so I’m just so happy and feeling loved . I’m tired from working and lack of sleep but my babies make me so incredibly happy .

I’m sad because my library card expired and I just realized . This is also the first moment I’m getting to myself in days so it’s nice to just sit in the quiet . I feel content and motivated to get some laundry put away .

Im sad because I heard one of my friends will be leaving . Im tired from working so much and my children make me feel so happy whenever I’m even just looking at them . So I’m happy , tired , exhausted , stressed , and anxious .

I’m feeling super tired because I have not had a break from teaching class and back to back meetings all day . Fridays is my busiest and most stressful day . It’s also my happiest day as I’m maximizing my student interaction . I can’t wait to spend the weekend with my kids so I’m also happy . Happy and tired and content .

I’m home with the children and they are a lot but I’m also happy because I get to spend time with them . My mother in law is also trying my patience is running thin so I’m trying to hard to feel patient but I am getting frustrated .

Im so exhausted after running after my kids for 4 hours at ORG    . Im so run down and feel like I’m gonna get sick which would suck because I have 3 jobs . I’m happy my kids had fun but I’m just extremely exhausted .
